patch: Scalegorge Waterscape is your home, isn't it? In gray fry's memories, I saw you two standing side-by-side.
Why don't you leave this to me, Lord Dan Heng? Use that Hidden Passage to reach the opposite shore. Perhaps gray fry is there, deeper inside...
Behind that scar lies what they called the "deepest depths." The rising steam tells me that gray fry is in there...
The search for gray fry might stretch on like an evernight without end... Be careful. Wandering through "Time" is no easy feat.
